scores.question: Which agreements contain a non-compete clause?
scores.answer:
The following agreements contain restrictions on competing activities:

- **ADAMSGOLFINC_03_21_2005-EX-10.17-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF** — prohibits endorsing or advising other product manufacturers or sellers. [ADAMSGOLFINC_03_21_2005-EX-10.17-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3]
- **ASHWORTHINC_01_29_1999-EX-10.(D)-PROMOTION AGREEMENT AND NANTZ COMMUNICATIONS, INC..PDF** — restricts endorsements of third-party sportswear, hats and shoes. [ASHWORTHINC_01_29_1999-EX-10.(D)-PROMOTION AGREEMENT AND NANTZ COMMUNICATIONS, INC..PDF p. 4]
- **ETELOS,INC_03_09_2004-EX-10.8-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF** — prohibits carrying competitive products without consent. [ETELOS,INC_03_09_2004-EX-10.8-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **FuseMedicalInc_20190321_10-K_EX-10.43_11575454_EX-10.43_Distributor Agreement.pdf** — prohibits acting as an agent for competitive goods. [FuseMedicalInc_20190321_10-K_EX-10.43_11575454_EX-10.43_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **GAINSCOINC_01_21_2010-EX-10.41-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF** — restricts endorsements of competing entities, products or services. [GAINSCOINC_01_21_2010-EX-10.41-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **HERTZGLOBALHOLDINGS,INC_07_07_2016-EX-10.4-INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT.PDF** — Section 9 restricts HERC’s vehicle rental and leasing activities. [HERTZGLOBALHOLDINGS,INC_07_07_2016-EX-10.4-INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT.PDF p. 9]
- **SCOUTCAMINC_05_12_2020-EX-10.22-SERVICES AGREEMENT.PDF** — prohibits competition during the agreement and for two years afterward. [SCOUTCAMINC_05_12_2020-EX-10.22-SERVICES AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.16_3074935_EX-10.16_Affiliate Agreement.pdf** — prohibits marketing competing products on specified landing pages. [SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.16_3074935_EX-10.16_Affiliate Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **TodosMedicalLtd_20190328_20-F_EX-4.10_11587157_EX-4.10_Marketing Agreement_ Reseller Agreement.pdf** — prohibits selling competing products or serving direct competitors. [TodosMedicalLtd_20190328_20-F_EX-4.10_11587157_EX-4.10_Marketing Agreement_ Reseller Agreement.pdf p. 4]

Two additional agreements have explicit non-compete headings, with qualifications:

- **BellringBrandsInc_20190920_S-1_EX-10.12_11817081_EX-10.12_Manufacturing Agreement1.pdf** — Section 18 is titled “Non-Exclusivity and Non-Competition”; subsection (b) is redacted. [BellringBrandsInc_20190920_S-1_EX-10.12_11817081_EX-10.12_Manufacturing Agreement1.pdf pp. 11–12]
- **TURNKEYCAPITAL,INC_07_20_2017-EX-1.1-Strategic Alliance Agreement.PDF** — contains “Confidentiality and non-compete,” but the visible wording addresses confidential information. [TURNKEYCAPITAL,INC_07_20_2017-EX-1.1-Strategic Alliance Agreement.PDF p. 3]

scores.question: Which agreements give a party audit rights?
scores.answer:
The following agreements grant audit rights, including rights to inspect accounting records:

- **Manufacturing Agreement** — Premier may inspect, copy and audit relevant manufacturing and cost records. [BellringBrandsInc_20190920_S-1_EX-10.12_11817081_EX-10.12_Manufacturing Agreement1.pdf p. 5]
- **Distributor Agreement** — Tripath may audit the distributor’s sales and inventory records. [ETELOS,INC_03_09_2004-EX-10.8-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]
- **Distributor Agreement** — The Supplier may inspect product sales and distribution accounts and records, at most annually. [FuseMedicalInc_20190321_10-K_EX-10.43_11575454_EX-10.43_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 5]
- **Service Agreement** — The HOF Entities may audit Constellation’s records relating to New Business for the preceding calendar year. [GpaqAcquisitionHoldingsInc_20200123_S-4A_EX-10.8_11951679_EX-10.8_Service Agreement.pdf p. 9]
- **Co-Branding Agreement** — Either party may inspect the other’s books concerning contractual obligations. [IntegrityMediaInc_20010329_10-K405_EX-10.17_2373875_EX-10.17_Co-Branding Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **Content License Agreement** — Licensors may inspect the Company’s books, records and materials concerning their licensed content. [MidwestEnergyEmissionsCorp_20080604_8-K_EX-10.2_3093976_EX-10.2_Content License Agreement.pdf p. 3]
- **Outsourcing Agreement** — SHPS may examine, copy and audit HPS’s Care Management Revenue records. [SYKESHEALTHPLANSERVICESINC_04_24_1998-EX-10.14-OUTSOURCING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **Affiliate Agreement** — Equidata may audit the Marketing Affiliate’s marketing practices and activities for compliance. [SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.16_3074935_EX-10.16_Affiliate Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **Marketing/Reseller Agreement** — Todos may have an independent auditor inspect and audit the reseller’s relevant accounting and sales records. [TodosMedicalLtd_20190328_20-F_EX-4.10_11587157_EX-4.10_Marketing Agreement_ Reseller Agreement.pdf p. 5]
